title: Derived counit compatibility before the homotopy mate identity
statement: Let f:X→Y be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], V an open of Y, U=f⁻¹V and f₀:U→V. Assume a common family of derived categories of module sheaves [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Choose the additive tensor-pullback instances and left-derived counits from exists_derivedPullbackComposition [lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-pullback-composition]. Write F=f_*, rX and rY for exact open restriction [def-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-direct-image, def-pc-derived-open-restriction-maps], a for the pinned derived adjunction [def-pc-t2-open-pinned-adjunction], c for the pinned pullback composition [def-pc-t2-open-pinned-composition], and t_h for the tensor restriction comparison [def-pc-open-pinned-single-tensor-restriction-iso]. For every homotopy complex I on X, the five-factor derived pullback square (inverse open comparison on Y, c(f₀,V.ι), transport across f₀≫V.ι=U.ι≫f, inverse c(U.ι,f), open comparison on X) preceded by Lf₀* of the inverse restriction factorization at F_h I followed by rY of the right-derived unit, and followed by rX of the a_f counit at Qh I and the source restriction factorization, equals the left-derived counit at rY_h(F_h I), followed by Qh of t_h inverse at F_h I composed with rX_h of the homotopy counit of f. This identity stops before the sectionwise direct-image mate identity and assumes neither boundedness nor invertibility of the right-derived unit.

proof.text: First normalize the derived unit and move it across the square using singleComplexOpen_unit_square_factorization. Then cancel the restriction and tensor comparisons using singleComplexOpen_restricted_counit_cancellation. Compose these two equalities by transitivity.

proof_origin.place: Stage-3 decomposition; each statement is a distinct part of the original argument.

theorem singleComplexOpen_pullback_counit_homotopy_factorization
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (V : Y.Opens)
    (I : HomotopyCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) (.up ℤ)) :
    let _ : ∀ {Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (k : Y ⟶ Z),
      (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback k).Additive :=
      @Classical.choose _ _ exists_derivedPullbackComposition
    let F := RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage f.toLRSHom.toShHom
    let F₀ := RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage (f ∣_ V).toLRSHom.toShHom
    let rY := schemeOpenRestriction Y V
    let rX := schemeOpenRestriction X (f ⁻¹ᵁ V)
    let a := @singleComplexOpenPinnedAdjunction.{u, w} _
    let c := @singleComplexOpenPinnedComposition.{u, w} _
    let ε := @Classical.choose _ _
      (Classical.choose_spec exists_derivedPullbackComposition)
    (derivedPullback (f ∣_ V)).map
        (rY.mapDerivedCategoryFactorsh.inv.app ((F.mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)).obj I) ≫
          rY.mapDerivedCategory.map (F.rightDerivedFunctorUnit.app I)) ≫
      ((derivedPullback (f ∣_ V)).mapIso
          ((singleComplexOpenPullbackIso Y V).symm.app
            ((schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj I))) ≪≫
        (c (f ∣_ V) V.ι).app ((schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj I)) ≪≫
        eqToIso (congrArg
          (fun k ↦ (derivedPullback k).obj
            ((schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj I)))
          (morphismRestrict_ι f V)) ≪≫
        (c (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι f).symm.app
          ((schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj I)) ≪≫
        (singleComplexOpenPullbackIso X (f ⁻¹ᵁ V)).app
          ((derivedPullback f).obj
            ((schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj I)))).hom ≫
      rX.mapDerivedCategory.map ((a f).counit.app (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj I)) ≫
      rX.mapDerivedCategoryFactorsh.hom.app I =
    (ε (f ∣_ V)).app ((rY.mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)).obj
      ((F.mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)).obj I)) ≫
      DerivedCategory.Qh.map
        ((openPinnedHomotopyTensorRestrictionIso f V (f ⁻¹ᵁ V) (f ∣_ V)
            (morphismRestrict_ι f V)).inv.app ((F.mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)).obj I) ≫
          (rX.mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)).map
            (((Classical.choose (Scheme.Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction f))
              |>.mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)).counit.app I))
